children: Enova, through its subsidiary OnDeck Asset Securitization IV, issued $500.251 million of asset-backed notes in four classes, with a weighted-average fixed coupon of 6.58%. Proceeds were used to purchase small-business loans that secure the notes, supporting the company's loan-funding capacity; the notes mature in December 2033, with the revolving period ending in November 2029.
: Final maturity in December 2033; revolving period ends November 2029
: Fund purchases of small-business loans and support general corporate purposes
